The component also supports the common properties [`id`](../common-properties/#id), [`hidden`](../common-properties/#hidden), [`grid`](../grid/), and [`pageBreak`](../page-break/).

| `actions`                                    | `(object \| object \| object \| object \| object)[]`                                                         | Yes      |               | Actions to run when the user selects the button.                                                                         |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].id`              | `"nextPage"`                                                                                                 | Yes      |               |                                                                                                                          |

Allowed values: "current", "currentAndPrevious", "all". |
